name: Walled Portals
title: Walled Portals
summary: A small walled fort on a sand-and-rock ridge (z 120) in the Dires. It is a 60 x 36 m court of flat-roofed halls with stake palisades, with two portals inside: Outside Accursed Halls and Ridge Tower, which leads back to the Drunken Madman. Acpedia notes the steps lead from outside to inside, which made it dangerous for young characters. It is a main entry into the Dires, and the twin of Outside Accursed Halls.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 42 m west of the walled fort, from 2 m to 24 m, over its spiked wall to reveal the two portal swirls inside; stay 9 m off the wall.
shots.notes: Boom rise: the drone rises from 2 m to 24 m, 42 m west of the walled fort on its sand-and-rock ridge. As it clears the halls' spiked roofline (LOS clear from about t 4 s), the two portal swirls inside the court (Outside Accursed Halls and Ridge Tower) come into view. The low west sun is behind the lens. The subject is hidden behind the wall until about t 4 s by design.
